main_mechanism: Gate the automatic fanout-aware cross-die placement weight by the observed cross-die net fraction: apply the 1.30/1.15/1.05 factors only when cross-die nets are at most 12% of all PlaceDB nets; otherwise keep unit net weights. An explicit non-unit cross_die_net_weight remains authoritative.
tradeoff_statement: The guard gives up potential cross-die timing pull on high-cut designs but avoids over-constraining a large shared-net set and adding local congestion. It does not change density, legality, area, power or runtime guarantees, and its 12% threshold is an empirically derived proxy rather than a calibrated criticality model.
portability_obligation: The rule depends on valid partition assignment, cross-die net identity and PlaceDB net/pin metadata. The threshold was inferred from the current nine training cells and makes no claim for unseen designs, PDKs, seeds or the hidden validation cases; explicit configuration weights continue to override the automatic path.
falsifier: Reject if the next official same-stage matrix does not improve over parent ecf5 or if bp_fe does not recover while bp and Ariane gains disappear; also reject on worse GRT overflow, DRC, legality or PDN/HBT/CTS contract failure, or if a comparable paid ablation shows the guard is indistinguishable from the parent.
downstream_obligations: Preserve partition_assignment.csv, cross_die_nets.csv, die_regions.json, placement DEF and both die ODBs in the existing stage contract.
Keep die fences, node-to-fence assignment, macro halo, density policy, legalization and PDN execution unchanged; only the automatic net-weight decision may change.
Keep HBT grid/placement, OPT, CTS clock and parasitic models, routing layers and adjustment, endpoint coverage and stage order intact.
Compare parent and child only for matched case/seed/config cells and same-stage reports; do not infer a stage contribution by raw cross-stage subtraction.
Retain all nine training cells, including the Ariane 1001 -100 clamp, in later evidence; unknown or unscored cells must remain unknown.
physical_invariants: Net weights remain finite and positive; only nets with assigned endpoints on both dies are candidates for automatic scaling.
When the cross-die fraction exceeds 12%, automatic weighting is disabled and cross-die weights remain at their incoming values.
Die assignment, physical connectivity, netlist identity, PDK/Liberty/LEF/SDC and clock definitions are not rewritten.
Placement units, target density, site/row geometry, macro-halo constraints and PDN special wires are untouched.
GRT overflow, DRC, unrouted nets, PDN special wires and HBT endpoint checks remain acceptance gates.
unknowns: selected_parent_cells is empty, so no same-stage parent/child cell evidence exists for causal comparison.
Critical endpoint migration is unknown until a verified parent/child endpoint identity mapping exists; local and final sign consistency is therefore unestablished.
The 12% threshold was inferred from three training cases and nine seeds; hidden-validation and cross-process generalization are unknown.
The training evidence is concentrated: all three bp_fe cells are negative, while the largest positive cell is Ariane seed 1003; equal-case averaging can hide this seed concentration.
The official score is authoritative; endpoint metrics and placement proxies are observations, and their exact mapping to the score is not assumed.
No invalid or missing cell was reported; the Ariane 1001 raw score was clamped to -100.

Only matched same-stage reports may be compared, and no cross-stage raw subtraction may be used to claim a stage cause.
task_analysis.critical_endpoint_migration: unknown: no verified endpoint identity mapping between parent and child is available, so no migration claim is supported.
task_analysis.endpoint_expected_effect: At post_grt, disabling automatic cross-die overweighting above 12% should move the three bp_fe cells back toward their reference deficits while retaining the prior bp and Ariane behavior; overflow should remain near the parent's zero/near-zero levels. Sign, magnitude and critical-set migration remain unknown.
task_analysis.alternative_explanation: The mixed parent result may instead reflect seed noise, placement density, legalization displacement, CTS or routing rather than cross-die weighting. Two short untested alternatives are uniformly damping all automatic factors and reverting the weighting entirely; neither is claimed causal without a comparable paid ablation.
